name: tracen-academy
displayName: Tracen Academy public data (AI Hayakawa Tazuna)
description: Read the public demo data of AI Hayakawa Tazuna, an unofficial fan project: Trainer Handbook rules, the academy calendar and G1/G2 races, training facilities and training-plan totals, and send non-personal feedback to a human review queue. Bundles the tracen-public skill and the local MCP server (tracen-api mcp-stdio).

tracen_api.title: tracen-api executable
tracen_api.description: The built API in your clone of tracen-ai-tazuna, e.g. <clone>/backend/target/release/tracen-api.exe (run `cargo build --release` in backend/ first). It finds the project's .env from its own folder, so PostgreSQL must be running.
